```flow
Process stops during a tool call -> Reopen storage and recover tasks
Reopen storage and recover tasks -> Inspect the tool and saved intent
Inspect the tool and saved intent -> {Stored and current policies both safe?}
{Stored and current policies both safe?} -> Re-execute under policy: yes and other limits permit
{Stored and current policies both safe?} -> Record an interrupted error result: no
Re-execute under policy -> Settle result

Settle result -> Subsequent model work
```
